message: Consider adding a module-level JSDoc comment explaining the extension's purpose and architecture.
The SVG generation could be extracted into a separate utility module for better testability and reusability.
Consider using async/await with fs.promises instead of synchronous file operations to avoid blocking the extension host.
The path matching logic should handle Windows path separators. Use path.normalize() for cross-platform compatibility.
Unsafe type assertion. Consider using a type guard or Zod schema validation instead of 'as' cast.
Using require() in ES modules is discouraged. Use import syntax instead.
Synchronous file I/O blocks the event loop. Use fs.promises.writeFile() instead.
This loop can be simplified using Array.reduce(): items.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0)
Consider using a strongly typed User interface instead of 'unknown' for better type safety.
Missing error handling for fetch failure. Wrap in try/catch and handle network errors gracefully.
Minimum VS Code version 1.85.0 is appropriate for the APIs used. Good choice!
